correctness.rationale: For irrational phase, the no-carry vector is exactly an upper-record event. Farey-neighbor intervals have length 1/(bd), giving the exact mean by Möbius inversion and a triangular harmonic-sum identity. Uniform harmonic estimates and the absolutely convergent derivatives of 1/zeta(s) at s=2 give all three asymptotic coefficients and O(log^2 N/N) error. The embedded standalone code checked 54 complete finite-denominator interval classifications, 939 positive cells and 55 exact finite mean identities; infinite claims rely on the proof, not those finite checks.

value.rationale: The mean number of upper records of a uniformly sampled irrational rotation is a natural global invariant; its log-squared growth, explicit linear correction, constant and effective remainder quantify a non-independent arithmetic effect not captured by individual carry probabilities or extremal-gap limits. The result holds uniformly across all integer horizons and is not a finite numerical cutoff. It does not claim a full distribution, variance or typical-phase law.
